How to split electricity when a roommate was away

Alex paid a $120 electricity bill for three roommates. They split the $30 fixed charge equally, at $10 each.

They agree to divide the $90 usage charge using days at home as an estimate. Alex and Maya were home for 30 days each, and Sam for 10.

Alex’s and Maya’s shares are $48.57 each, and Sam’s is $22.86. Maya and Sam repay Alex their shares.
